## ⚗️ What we build

| Project | Stack | One-liner |
|---|---|---|
| 🛡️ [**talus-process-monitor**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/talus-process-monitor) | Rust · eBPF | Behavioral ransomware detection with automated kill response — ~280k events/s, single static binary |
| ⚡ [**externum**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/externum) | Python · self-hosted | A language that compiles to Python, Bash **and** native bytecode — 400+ tests, browser REPL |
| 🌌 [**Aurora**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Aurora) | TypeScript · zero deps | A complete operating system in your browser — window manager, VFS, 14 apps, `.aurora` snapshots |
| 🔐 [**quantum-shield**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/quantum-shield) | Rust | Post-quantum file encryption: ML-KEM-768 + AES-GCM |
| 🐧 [**linux-aegis**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/linux-aegis) | C | Linux kernel security module |
| 🛰️ [**fortis**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/fortis) | Rust · RISC-V | Chain-of-trust for embedded systems |
| 🗡️ [**CyberForge**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/CyberForge) | Python | Port scanner, packet analysis, hash cracking — the offensive toolbox |
| 📡 [**pqbit**](https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/pqbit) | Rust | Post-quantum safe transport experiments |

## 🧭 Principles

```text
$ cat MANIFESTO.txt
1. code over claims        — every feature ships with tests and CI, or it doesn't ship
2. visibility is defense   — you can't protect what you can't see (ask our eBPF hooks)
3. own your stack          — zero-dependency where possible, auditable everywhere
4. open by default         — MIT licensed, issues are welcome, egos are not
```
